title: Functions
explain: You annotate each parameter and the return type, and TypeScript checks every call against them. Add `?` to make a parameter optional, or give it a default value. Return types are usually inferred, but writing them on exported functions makes the contract clear.
exercise: Write a typed function `average(nums: number[])` that returns 0 for an empty list.
tip: Don't leave parameters untyped under `strict`. An implicit `any` is an error, and for good reason.
